name: OSINT — Source Verification
description: Trace a digital claim or artifact to its origin, test authenticity/context, corroborate independently, and report confidence with provenance.

tasks.name: Preserve the artifact
tasks.objective: Capture the supplied URL/file/post and surrounding context before analysis: content, visible metadata, timestamps, account/page identity, archive copies where lawful, retrieval time, and hashes for downloaded evidence. Preserve originals and note anything unavailable or altered by the platform.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Original evidence and retrieval context are preserved separately from analyst notes.

tasks.name: Trace origin and publication chain
tasks.objective: Find the earliest verifiable appearance, distinguish original publisher from reposters/aggregators, map edits/captions/translations, and identify whether apparently separate reports derive from one upstream source.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Corroboration does not count derivative copies as independent sources.

tasks.name: Inspect authenticity and context
tasks.objective: Inspect metadata where available, file/container structure, visual/audio continuity, screenshots/crops, quoted text, document formatting, timestamps, account history, archive history, and contextual mismatches. Treat AI/deepfake detectors as weak signals unless independently validated.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Authenticity findings distinguish confirmed anomalies from detector guesses.

tasks.name: Corroborate independently
tasks.objective: Seek primary records, independent eyewitness/media, official data, geospatial evidence, archived pages, contemporaneous reporting, and contradictory evidence. Prefer sources whose information-generation process is independent of the original claim.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Material claims have independent support or are labeled uncorroborated.

tasks.name: Attempt falsification
tasks.objective: Search for prior uses of the media, alternate locations/dates, parody/satire, manipulated excerpts, mistranslation, account impersonation, synthetic generation, and mundane explanations that fit the evidence better.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The strongest plausible alternative explanation is explicitly tested.

tasks.name: Issue verification report
tasks.objective: Report what is verified, contradicted, unresolved, or unverifiable; include the provenance chain, strongest evidence, source independence, timestamps, transformations, confidence, and what additional evidence would change the conclusion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every conclusion is traceable to preserved evidence and does not exceed it.
